Hi Mikael — quick technical checklist from our side: 

- The lab bench has a standard workstation with an available PCIe riser slot and a single 1Gbps RJ45 port. Power outlets are standard 120V NEMA. External eGPU enclosures are fine but we require any external drives be encrypted during transport and storage.
- Please confirm whether your enclosure requires Thunderbolt 3/USB-C host; we have an adapter but prefer to know ahead of time.
- We'll prepare a locked equipment locker; please label devices on arrival.
- I attached a one-page lab equipment handling waiver (lab_equipment_waiver.docx) — please confirm signature from your team prior to bench access.
- AV check: I can be there 08:30 on 9/28 for a hands-on test; if that changes let me know.

Thanks — Marcus
